# GitHub configuration

This folder owns collaboration templates, the instruction bridge, and showcase automation. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

- [ISSUE_TEMPLATE](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/README.md) defines task, research, and bug context.
- [PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) captures scope, validation, documentation, and risks.
- [workflows](workflows/README.md) owns Pages checks/deployment.
- [copilot-instructions.md](copilot-instructions.md) links shared agent guidance; it does not own product policy.

Keep issue evidence separate from accepted decisions in [the log](../docs/DECISIONS.md). Template edits are documentation changes; workflow changes must also be checked against the actual workflow and release boundaries.
